name: lane
description: Multi-requirement parallel orchestrator: Planner + Workers for git worktrees

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lane/core && npm run build -w @lane/planner && npm run build -w @lane/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lane/core && npm run test -w @lane/planner
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lane/core && npm run typecheck -w @lane/planner && npm run typecheck -w @lane/cli
